intro.text: The flighty, chattering queen of Arelon, King Iadon's wife, who welcomes Sarene to Kae.
The cheerful, scatterbrained queen of Arelon, who married King Iadon soon after the Reod.

items.text: Eshen married Iadon soon after the Reod and his rise to the throne, a few years after Raoden's mother had died. The match was probably made for her family's wealth, which helped Iadon set up his first government.

Eshen welcomed Sarene when she arrived in Kae after Raoden's 'death', showed her to her rooms, gave her some extra clothes and arranged Raoden's funeral. Eshen was known to be scatterbrained, but Sarene suspected her nervous chatter was a way of steering clear of the truth about Raoden's death.
Eshen belonged to the women's needlework circle that Sarene joined, and through it briefly took part in Sarene's fencing lessons. She went with Iadon to Roial's ball.
Eshen knew nothing of her husband's part in the Jeskeri Mysteries. His disgrace and death left her a shell of her former self.

When the people of Kae were rounded up for execution during the invasion, Eshen and several women from the fencing lessons took up weapons against the Fjordell soldiers. Making the most of the soldiers' surprise, Eshen fought well until one stabbed her through the chest. Her death broke the others' will, and they soon surrendered.

appearance.text: Eshen is short and slight, with brownish-blonde hair starting to grey, and a high-pitched voice.

personality.text: Eshen is very domestic, flighty and not at all clever. She chatters to fill any silence, preferring idle babble to serious talk, and stays cheerful and bubbly almost no matter what. Roial calls her empty-headed.

items.text: Eshen's marriage to Iadon was seen as one of convenience, not love, and Sarene noted how unlike each other they were. Eshen's fixation on fashion and food only fed Iadon's low opinion of women. Since he openly brushed her aside, she kept her distance, which may be why he could keep so much from her.
